start: Member page of a member whose gym plan ends on the 30th; the member was ill for a week; owner signed in, online; set-up: dark

steps.action: Do "Freeze a membership or add extra days" in dark mode.
user_sees: Every text, icon and chart easy to read
must_not: Dark text on a dark background, a white flash between screens, or an unreadable chart or picture

steps.action: On the plan that ends last tap "Freeze / extra days"
user_sees: "Reason" with "Freeze – Medical" picked, "Freeze – Travel", "Freeze – Other", "Gift – Extra days"
"How many days" with "7 days" picked, "15 days", "30 days"
"New last day: <7 days later>" and "Valid till then (<how far from today>)."
must_not: A new last day that is not exactly 7 days after the old one

steps.action: Tap "15 days"
user_sees: The box shows 15; "New last day" moves; the button reads "Add 15 days"
must_not: The button still saying 7

steps.action: Tap "Add 15 days"
must_not: The days added twice
A receipt or a charge made for free days

steps.action: Look at the plan and its history
